title: knema lunduensis
intro: Knema lunduensis, commonly known as the Lundu nut tree, is a plant species native to Borneo. It is a member of the Myristicaceae family and is valued for its edible nuts and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Knema lunduensis include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, improve cardiovascular health, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and it contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and alkaloids.
